fixtures.name: main
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT
        (i - 2000)::INTEGER AS id,
        (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i - 2000) * 1.5 END)::DOUBLE AS amt,
        CAST(i AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS price,
        (CASE WHEN i % 13 = 0 THEN '' ELSE 'n' || i END) AS name,
        (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'v' || i END) AS nname,
        (DATE '2020-01-01' + i::INTEGER) AS d,
        (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i % 3 = 0) END) AS flag,
        (CASE WHEN i % 17 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01' + to_milliseconds(i) END)::TIMESTAMP_MS AS ts
      FROM range(1, 4000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 500)

fixtures.name: coded
fixtures.copy: COPY (SELECT (CASE i % 3 WHEN 0 THEN -1.5 WHEN 1 THEN 1.5 ELSE 3.0 END)::DOUBLE AS amt, (i % 5)::BIGINT AS k, i AS id FROM range(0, 4096) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 4096)

agg:sum_count.aggregate: sum(id) AS s, count(id) AS c
agg:sum_count.head: SELECT sum(id), count(id) FROM '{path}'

agg:minmax.aggregate: min(amt) AS mn, max(amt) AS mx
agg:minmax.head: SELECT min(amt), max(amt) FROM '{path}'

agg:count_star.aggregate: count(*) AS n, sum(amt) AS s
agg:count_star.head: SELECT count(*), sum(amt) FROM '{path}'

agg:avg.aggregate: avg(amt) AS a, min(name) AS mn
agg:avg.head: SELECT avg(amt), min(name) FROM '{path}'

agg:avg_dec.aggregate: avg(price) AS a, avg_state(price) AS sp, avg_state(amt) AS sa
agg:avg_dec.head: SELECT sum(price)::VARCHAR, count(price), sum(price), count(price), sum(amt), count(amt) FROM '{path}'

agg:strlen.aggregate: avg(strlen(nname)) AS a, sum(strlen(name)) AS s, count(strlen(nname)) AS c
agg:strlen.head: SELECT avg(strlen(nname)), sum(strlen(name)), count(strlen(nname)) FROM '{path}'

agg:case_arg.aggregate: sum(CASE WHEN amt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE id END) AS s, max(CASE WHEN name LIKE 'n1%' THEN id END) AS m
agg:case_arg.head: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN amt IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE id END), max(CASE WHEN name LIKE 'n1%' THEN id END) FROM '{path}'

agg:null_arith.aggregate: sum(amt * 2) AS s, count(amt * 2) AS c, avg(amt + id) AS a, min(amt - 1) AS mn, max(amt * id) AS mx
agg:null_arith.head: SELECT sum(amt * 2), count(amt * 2), avg(amt + id), min(amt - 1), max(amt * id) FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_simple.head: SELECT flag, count(id) AS c FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_arith.head: SELECT (id + 1) AS id_plus1, sum(price) AS s FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_concat.aggregate: max(price) AS mx, min(price) AS mn
groupby:gb_concat.head: SELECT (name || '_z') AS concat, max(price) AS mx, min(price) AS mn FROM '{path}'

groupby-o:gb_concat.aggregate: max(price) AS mx, min(price) AS mn

groupby:gb_coalesce.head: SELECT count(id) AS c, coalesce(nname, 'NA') AS coal FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_int_plus_float.head: SELECT (id + 0.5) AS h, count(*) AS n FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_float_times_int.head: SELECT (amt * 2) AS a2, count(*) AS n FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_int_times_float.head: SELECT (id * amt) AS p, count(*) AS n FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_decimal_plus_int.head: SELECT (price + id) AS q, count(*) AS n FROM '{path}'

groupby:gb_null_input.aggregate: sum(amt) AS s, min(amt) AS mn, count(amt) AS c, avg(amt) AS a, max(name) AS mx
groupby:gb_null_input.head: SELECT flag, sum(amt) AS s, min(amt) AS mn, count(amt) AS c, avg(amt) AS a, max(name) AS mx FROM '{path}'

groupby-o:gb_null_input.aggregate: sum(amt) AS s, min(amt) AS mn, count(amt) AS c, avg(amt) AS a, max(name) AS mx

groupby:gb_avg_state.aggregate: avg_state(amt) AS a, avg_state(price) AS p, avg(price) AS m
groupby:gb_avg_state.head: SELECT flag, sum(amt) AS a__sum, count(amt) AS a__count, sum(price) AS p__sum, count(price) AS p__count, NULL::VARCHAR AS m FROM '{path}'

groupby-o:gb_avg_state.aggregate: avg_state(amt) AS a, avg_state(price) AS p, avg(price) AS m

query.aggregate: sum(amt) AS s, min(amt) AS lo, max(amt) AS hi, avg(amt) AS a, count(amt) AS c

oracle.sql: SELECT sum(amt), min(amt), max(amt), avg(amt), count(amt) FROM '{path}' WHERE amt > 0.1 AND amt < 1

cases.sql: SELECT k, sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE amt > 0.1 AND amt < 1) AS s, count(*) AS n FROM '{path}' GROUP BY k

oracle.sql: SELECT k, sum(amt) FILTER (WHERE amt > 0.1 AND amt < 1) AS s, count(*) AS n FROM '{path}' GROUP BY k
